scientific_integrity: Complete assumptions, local multiplier proof, period-annulus alternative, reproducibility checker and residual limitations are supplied. No claim of independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only regular cycles with exactly four transverse crossings across the two straight strip boundaries. Gives no existence criterion or statement for sliding/grazing, other itineraries or global basin stability. One potentially relevant three-zone mixed-center/saddle source was available only as an abstract; historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Hyperbolicity dichotomy for four-crossing cycles in three-strip Hamiltonian flows
